name: Social Media Automator
author: LobsterLabs
description: Automatically generate social media posts from articles. Supports Twitter, LinkedIn, and Instagram.
longDescription:
This skill transforms your long-form content into engaging social media posts across multiple platforms. Perfect for content marketers, solopreneurs, and agencies who want to scale their social presence.

Features:
- Twitter thread generation (3-10 tweets)
- LinkedIn post creation
- Instagram captions with hashtags
- Multiple variations for A/B testing
- Scheduling integration ready

This skill works seamlessly with the SEO Content Engine for full content automation.

Ideal for:
- Content marketers scaling distribution
- Solopreneurs building personal brand
- Agencies managing multiple clients
- Anyone tired of manual social media posting

examples.command: Generate Twitter thread from my article "10 Best AI Tools" - 7 tweets
Create LinkedIn post from "How I Automated My Content Workflow"
Create social media posts from [paste article text]

pricing.services: This free skill powers LobsterLabs paid social media services. Hire us at lobsterlabs@proton.me
